algorithm_title: Swap 2 variables without using a third variable
evidence_summary: This suite provides limited behavioural evidence using one predefined common behavioural test, with partial branch evidence. Frozen values exercise the mixed-type branch only; numeric-numeric and string-string branches are not externally injectable.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on the predefined common behavioural test, the behaviours exposed by the frozen program interface, and the declared coverage dimensions: branch behaviour.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret behavioural accuracy as agreement for the specific exercised scenario or scenarios, not as strong evidence of general behavioural equivalence.
coverage_limitations: Frozen values exercise the mixed-type branch only; numeric-numeric and string-string branches are not externally injectable.
manual_review_targets: Use structural criteria C3/A3/F2-F4 to review the unexecuted type branches.
